 1525 Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget.add(:EJECTBUTTON,
 1526   proc { |item, battler, user, move, switched_battlers, battle|
 1527     next if !switched_battlers.empty?
 1528     next if battle.pbAllFainted?(battler.idxOpposingSide)
 1529     next if !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(battler.index)
 1530     battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", battler)
 1531     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is switched out with the {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.itemName))
 1532     battler.pbConsumeItem(true, false)
 1533     newPkmn = battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(battler.index)   # Owner chooses
 1534     next if newPkmn < 0
 1535     battle.pbRecallAndReplace(battler.index, newPkmn)
 1536     battle.pbClearChoice(battler.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
 1537     switched_battlers.push(battler.index)
 1538     battle.moldBreaker = false if battler.index == user.index
 1539     battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler.index)
 1540   }
 1541 )

 1543 Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget.add(:REDCARD,
 1544   proc { |item, battler, user, move, switched_battlers, battle|
 1545     next if !switched_battlers.empty? || user.fainted?
 1546     newPkmn = battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(user.index, true)   # Random
 1547     next if newPkmn < 0
 1548     battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", battler)
 1549     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} held up its {2} against {3}!",
 1550        battler.pbThis, battler.itemName, user.pbThis(true)))
 1551     battler.pbConsumeItem
 1552     if user.hasActiveAbility?(:SUCTIONCUPS) && !battle.moldBreaker
 1553       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(user)
 1554       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
 1555         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself!", user.pbThis))
 1556       else
 1557         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself with {2}!", user.pbThis, user.abilityName))
 1558       end
 1559       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(user)
 1560       next
 1561     end
 1562     if user.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
 1563       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchored itself with its roots!", user.pbThis))
 1564       next
 1565     end
 1566     battle.pbRecallAndReplace(user.index, newPkmn, true)
 1567     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was dragged out!", user.pbThis))
 1568     battle.pbClearChoice(user.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
 1569     switched_battlers.push(user.index)
 1570     battle.moldBreaker = false
 1571     battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(user.index)
 1572   }
 1573 )

 1579 Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromUser.add(:LIFEORB,
 1580   proc { |item, user, targets, move, numHits, battle|
 1581     next if !user.takesIndirectDamage?
 1582     next if !move.pbDamagingMove? || numHits == 0
 1583     hitBattler = false
 1584     targets.each do |b|
 1585       hitBattler = true if !b.damageState.unaffected && !b.damageState.substitute
 1586       break if hitBattler
 1587     end
 1588     next if !hitBattler
 1589     PBDebug.log("[Item triggered] #{user.pbThis}'s #{user.itemName} (recoil)")
 1590     user.pbReduceHP(user.totalhp / 10)
 1591     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} lost some of its HP!", user.pbThis))
 1592     user.pbItemHPHealCheck
 1593     user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
 1594   }

 1597 # NOTE: In the official games, Shell Bell does not prevent Emergency Exit/Wimp
 1598 #       Out triggering even if Shell Bell heals the holder back to 50% HP or
 1599 #       more. Essentials ignores this exception.
 1600 Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromUser.add(:SHELLBELL,
 1601   proc { |item, user, targets, move, numHits, battle|
 1602     next if !user.canHeal?
 1603     totalDamage = 0
 1604     targets.each { |b| totalDamage += b.damageState.totalHPLost }
 1605     next if totalDamage <= 0
 1606     user.pbRecoverHP(totalDamage / 8)
 1607     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} restored a little HP using its {2}!",
 1608        user.pbThis, user.itemName))
 1609   }
 1610 )

 1628 Battle::ItemEffects::OnEndOfUsingMove.add(:LEPPABERRY,
 1629   proc { |item, battler, battle, forced|
 1630     next false if !forced && !battler.canConsumeBerry?
 1631     found_empty_moves = []
 1632     found_partial_moves = []
 1633     battler.pokemon.moves.each_with_index do |move, i|
 1634       next if move.total_pp <= 0 || move.pp == move.total_pp
 1635       (move.pp == 0) ? found_empty_moves.push(i) : found_partial_moves.push(i)
 1636     end
 1637     next false if found_empty_moves.empty? && (!forced || found_partial_moves.empty?)
 1638     itemName = GameData::Item.get(item).name
 1639     PBDebug.log("[Item triggered] #{battler.pbThis}'s #{itemName}") if forced
 1640     amt = 10
 1641     ripening = false
 1642     if battler.hasActiveAbility?(:RIPEN)
 1643       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler, forced)
 1644       amt *= 2
 1645       ripening = true
 1646     end
 1647     battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", battler) if !forced
 1648     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler) if ripening
 1649     choice = found_empty_moves.first
 1650     choice = found_partial_moves.first if forced && choice.nil?
 1651     pkmnMove = battler.pokemon.moves[choice]
 1652     pkmnMove.pp += amt
 1653     pkmnMove.pp = pkmnMove.total_pp if pkmnMove.pp > pkmnMove.total_pp
 1654     battler.moves[choice].pp = pkmnMove.pp
 1655     moveName = pkmnMove.name
 1656     if forced
 1657       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} restored its {2}'s PP.", battler.pbThis, moveName))
 1658     else
 1659       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} restored its {3}'s PP!", battler.pbThis, itemName, moveName))
 1660     end
 1661     next true
 1662   }
 1663 )
